meta.source: Blizzard Game Data journal-encounter + Wowhead tooltip API
meta.readMe: Ability text and damage magnitudes come from Wowhead's tooltip endpoint, which is the only source carrying tuned numbers for this tier -- Blizzard's /data/wow/spell/<id> returns 404 for these ids and the in-game journal text ships 'X' placeholders. A magnitude here is ONE difficulty's value and the endpoint does not say which; cross-check against measured damage taken in profiles/<spec>-<difficulty>.json before quoting it as a Mythic number.

encounter.name: Sszorak
encounter.description: A horrifying creature, warped by Ula'tek's toxic venom, Sszorak is a brutal instrument of vengeance. Calling upon the winds that howl deep within Atal'Utek, it tears apart any living creature it encounters.

notes.title: Overview
notes.bodyText: Sszorak relentlessly assaults players with [Apex Predator] combination attacks and noxious [Venomous Surge] globs. The Altar of the Six Winds unleashes [Raging Crosswinds] and eventually builds to a massive [Howling Maelstrom] that pushes players around the arena.
bullets: Sszorak relentlessly assaults players with [Apex Predator] combination attacks and noxious [Venomous Surge] globs. The Altar of the Six Winds unleashes [Raging Crosswinds] and eventually builds to a massive [Howling Maelstrom] that pushes players around the arena.

notes.title: Damage Dealers
notes.bodyText:
$bullet;[Venomous Surge] inflicts raid-wide damage. Players farther from the affected player receive less damage.
$bullet;[Raging Crosswinds] inflicts damage over time before knocking affected players in the indicated direction.
$bullet;[Dig In] increases Sszorak's damage taken during [Howling Maelstrom].

abilities.title: Howling Maelstrom
abilities.description: The Altar of the Six Winds unleashes a succession of gales across the arena. Each gale pushes players in its indicated direction.

abilities.title: Dig In
abilities.description: Sszorak hunkers down during Howling Maelstrom, increasing his damage taken by 30% for 25 sec.

abilities.title: Serpent's Fury
abilities.description:
Sszorak marks a player and gains rage over time. When at least 14 players are within 8 yards of the marked player, Sszorak casts To the Slaughter and consumes his rage.

Upon reaching 100 rage, Sszorak gains Unbound Ferocity and begins slaughtering players.

abilities.title: Unbound Ferocity
abilities.description: Sszorak flies into a killing frenzy, increasing his damage done by 500% and attack speed by 50% until all his foes are left dead or dying.

abilities.title: To the Slaughter
abilities.description: Sszorak consumes his rage and charges toward the player marked by Serpent's Fury, inflicting 333363 Physical damage to players struck and applying Virulence.

abilities.title: Virulence
abilities.description:
Toxifies a target for 5 sec, inflicting 125011 Nature damage every 1 sec.

Upon removal the toxin bursts, inflicting 833407 Nature damage to players struck and afflicting them with Virulence.

abilities.title: Apex Predator
abilities.description: Sszorak executes multiple attacks in rapid succession. Taunt effects can change his current target while casting.

abilities.title: Ravage
abilities.description: Sszorak slashes repeatedly, inflicting 3500308 Physical damage to all players in a frontal cone and increasing their damage taken from Ravage by 600% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Mutilate
abilities.description:
Sszorak rakes his venom-coated claws in a frontal cone, inflicting 4792088 Nature damage split evenly among players struck and afflicting them with Mutilated Gash.

If Mutilate strikes 5 or fewer players, it inflicts deadly damage.

abilities.title: Mutilated Gash
abilities.description:
Players struck by Mutilate are lacerated with toxic wounds, suffering 875077 Nature damage every 1 sec for 22 sec. This effect is split evenly among players struck.

Increases the damage taken from Mutilate by 0%.

abilities.title: Tempest
abilities.description: Sszorak forms vortices of poisonous wind which spiral around the arena. These inflict 500044 Nature damage plus an additional 208352 Nature damage every 1 sec and reduce movement speed by 30% for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Venomous Surge
abilities.description:
Sszorak heaves fresh venom onto several players, inflicting 100009 Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

Upon expiration, the venom detonates forming a Viscous Cyst and inflicting 500044 Nature damage to all players, decreasing in damage as distance increases.

abilities.title: Viscous Cyst
abilities.description:
A glob of unstable toxin forms for 2 min. Upon contact or expiration, the glob bursts, knocking all players away and inflicting 500044 Nature damage. The toxin then inflicts 50004 Nature damage every 1 sec and reduces movement speed by 30% for 5 sec. This effect stacks.

The toxins cling to players, allowing them to better adhere to the ground while it persists.

abilities.title: Caustic Claws
abilities.description: Sszorak flings toxin from his claws, inflicting 750066 Nature damage to players within 6 yards of impact and forming a pool of Caustic Residue.

abilities.title: Caustic Residue
abilities.description: The pool of sizzling acid corrodes players within it, inflicting 41670 Nature damage every 1 sec and increasing their damage taken by 30%.

abilities.title: Raging Crosswinds
abilities.description:
The Altar of the Six Winds imbues several players with roiling winds, inflicting 20835 Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

Upon expiration, the winds inflict 500044 Nature damage to players within 6 yards. The winds then knock each affected player in the indicated direction and apply Turbulent Gusts.

abilities.title: Turbulent Gusts
abilities.description: Turbulent winds hold the target aloft, reducing their falling speed for 10 sec. Contacting another player affected by Turbulent Gusts causes the winds to dissipate.

abilities.title: Corroding Venom
abilities.description: Sszorak's venom-laced claws corrode his target's armor, causing melee attacks to increase Physical damage taken by the target by 3% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Ula'tek's Presence
abilities.description: The Altar of the Six Winds emits a caustic mist, inflicting 83341 Nature damage to all players every 2 sec.
